description: Export 2-24 evenly spaced, file-verified frames from an active-sequence range in one bridge round trip for visual review. This samples rendered output; it does not prove playback, audio, or editorial quality.

end_seconds.description: Optional positive range end in seconds (default: sequence end)

frame_count.description: Number of evenly spaced frames to export (default: 6; minimum: 2; maximum: 24)

output_dir.description: Existing directory where review_001.png through review_NNN.png will be written

start_seconds.description: Optional non-negative range start in seconds (default: sequence start)

name: export_sequence_review_frames

data.description: Tool-specific result data when ok is true.

error.description: Failure detail when ok is false.

title: Export Sequence Review Frames
